title: SOX ACK envelope body
description: Reserved body type for application-level acknowledgement messages. A 'sox-ack' signals that the receiver received and accepted the referenced message (identified by correlation_id). This is an application-layer ACK; it is not a transport-layer delivery guarantee. See spec/primitives/ack-nack.md for semantics.

correlation_id.description: The message_id (or caller-supplied correlation_id) of the message being acknowledged. The receiver copies this from the original message's correlation_id field, or from its message_id if no correlation_id was set.

acknowledged_channel.description: Optional. The channel on which the acknowledged message was originally sent. Helps the sender disambiguate when the same correlation_id appears on multiple channels.

detail.description: Optional. Free-form human-readable detail about the acknowledgement (e.g. 'Will process by T+2'). MUST NOT contain sensitive information.

examples.detail: Received clarification request; will respond within 2 LLM turns.
